summary: Frontend-only FSOS demo exercised end-to-end via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Covered: Command Room load, role switcher, global search, BO Studio list + filters, Idea Card modal with all 6 tabs, Create Idea flow, Approval flow (Founder), Assignment flow (owner/reviewer/deadline persistence), Version production (add-link), HPN Desk quick-record drawer, Production board/table/people/mine + bulk-assign bar, Distribution matrix/calendar/bank/today, Matrix side panel, Calendar bank-drawer with drawer-place options, Bulk Placement full flow (select → next → preview table → confirm), Performance capture/ideas/cycles tabs with cycle-select+cycle-table, Settings IPs/People/Approvals&Rules, Demo Clock reset button, and localStorage persistence via full browser reload (created idea 'TEST_Persist_Reload' persisted; fsos_db_v1 ~200KB). Only console noise: Radix Dialog a11y warnings about missing DialogTitle (non-blocking). No JS runtime errors, no dead buttons for the flows tested.

design_issues.screen: All Radix Dialogs (Create Idea, Idea Card modal, Bulk Placement, HPN quick drawer, Add IP)
issues: Radix warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for accessibility. Wrap or add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle in every DialogContent. Fires repeatedly in console when any dialog opens.

observations_needing_confirmation: Settings > Categories tab: `data-testid="cat-add"` not found in DOM after clicking the 'Categories' sub-tab. Every other Settings sub-tab (IPs add-ip-btn, People add-user-btn, Approvals bo-approver) was found. Main agent should confirm the testid is set on the Categories add button.

Idea Card > Page Versions tab: `submit-review-<versionId>`, `approve-version-<versionId>`, `request-changes-<versionId>` testids were not present when the tab opened for a fresh idea (only `add-link-<versionId>` was, count=4). This appears to be intentional – buttons render only after a link is added/state transitions – but not fully exercised because the add-link dialog input flow submits via a custom form; verifying the full submit-review → approve/request-changes path was not completed in a single script run. Recommend a manual sanity check or main agent self-test.
action_items: Add `DialogTitle` (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to every Radix DialogContent to silence a11y warnings.
Verify Settings > Categories 'Add' button has data-testid="cat-add".
critical_code_review_comments: Persistence uses localStorage key 'fsos_db_v1' – confirmed working across reload (~200KB payload).
Recommend files >700 LOC in /app/frontend/src/domain/store.js and Distribution.js be audited for potential splitting; not blocking.
Repeated a11y console errors on every dialog open pollute logs – easy fix.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (18/19 explicit flows verified; 1 minor testid gap on cat-add)

test_credentials: None – no auth. Role switching via data-testid="role-switcher" + act-as-u-<n>. Default user u-1 = Jaskaran Singh (Founder/Admin).
seed_data_creation: Created two test ideas via UI: 'TEST_Automated Idea' and 'TEST_Persist_Reload' in the two browser sessions (each session is fresh localStorage). No global seed pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright browser_automation sessions are FRESH – localStorage does not carry between calls. For persistence tests, do create + reload within one script. Public URL: https://fsos-stage.preview.emergentagent.com. All flows use kebab-case data-testids. Radix Select requires clicking trigger, waiting 300–500ms, then clicking a [role=option]. Idea modal is a Radix Dialog closed via Escape. Bulk placement flow works: open-bulk-btn → bulk-placement-dialog → bulk-select-<ideaId> → bulk-next → bulk-preview-table → bulk-confirm.
